title: Conflict Resolution and Management: Main Exam, 9 December 2021
department: Department of Social and Development Studies
programme: Bachelor of Social Work and Administration
instructions: ANSWER QUESTION ONE AND ANY OTHER TWO QUESTIONS.

parts.text: Explain, giving examples, the term conflict.
Discuss four levels of conflict, giving an example in each case.
Explain the 'win-win' approach as applied to conflict resolution.
Define negotiation. What are the advantages and disadvantages of negotiation?
Discuss the methods used in solving conflicts in a workplace.
What is the importance of community cohesion?
List and explain the traditional approaches to conflict resolution.
Discuss the legal and ethical practices which should be observed while resolving conflicts.
Explain what an intractable conflict is, giving an example.
Discuss the underlying causes of intractable conflicts.
Discuss the challenges parties encounter while reaching an agreement.

items.text: Discuss the causes and effects of frequent conflict witnessed in Kenya.
